gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have DIPG, as defined below, to be eligible for this protocol.
OR a pontine-based lesion that is biopsy proven non-pilocytic, WHO II-IV glioma.
Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma; Pediatric Brainstem Glioma; Pediatric Brainstem Gliosarcoma, Recurrent; Pediatric Cancer; Pediatric Brain Tumor; Diffuse Glioma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Population is paediatric/young-adult DIPG only (not_glioblastoma), but conditions list 'Pediatric Brainstem Gliosarcoma, Recurrent', and gliosarcoma named in conditions could be read as glioblastoma named (mixed_glioma_gbm_named).

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Marizomib + Panobinostat: If tolerated,combination of Marizomib: and panobinostat on subsequent cycles.
Marizomib has not been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as a treatment for any disease.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Given the poor prognosis of all patients with DIPG, patients may enroll at any point in their disease course provided they have received standard radiation therapy (also defined below) and meet all other eligibility requirements.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma drug concentrations and pharmacokinetic parameters will be presented in tabular and graphical form

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Marizomib + Panobinostat: If tolerated,combination of Marizomib: and panobinostat on subsequent cycles.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Marizomib: All patients will initially receive marizomib (MRZ) alone (Course A1)
[EXPERIMENTAL] Marizomib + Panobinostat: If tolerated,combination of Marizomib: and panobinostat on subsequent cycles.
Panobinostat has not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma but it has been approved for other uses.

source_quote.quote: H3K27M status will be assessed in patients when tissue is available, but patients are eligible regardless of H3K27M status.

coder_notes: Paediatric DIPG trial (age <22; stdAges CHILD, ADULT -> mixed_age). Coded not_glioblastoma per manual (paediatric DIPG only); 'Pediatric Brainstem Gliosarcoma, Recurrent' in conditions flagged for adjudication. Marizomib given alone in Part A then with panobinostat in Part B; coded experimental_combination overall (monotherapy in arm 'Marizomib'). PK is plasma only. Treatment setting 'both': enrolment at any point after standard radiation, progressive disease allowed (keyword 'Progressive DIPG'). H3K27M assessed but not required; not candidate-matched.
